hints.content: A relative maximum point is a point that is higher than all other graph points around it. It's like the highest point on a "peak."

The graph has three relative maximum points in the given section. One at $(-6,7)$, one at $(-1,3)$, and one at $(3,3)$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A function is made up of line segments and curved lines. A line segment connects negative eight, two to negative six, seven. A line segment connects negative six, seven to negative four, negative three. A line segment connects negative four, negative three to negative one, three. Then the function decreases at a non linear rate through the point zero, negative two until one, negative seven. Then it increases at a non linear rate to three, three. Then it decreases at a non linear rate to five, negative seven. A line segment connects five, negative seven to seven, negative eight.
